##Apply the "date anchor" technique to fix the formation date in memory  
The document states the municipality was established on 1 January 2016. Associate this date with a familiar event or calendar marker (e.g., "the first day of the year when I started learning about French communes"). Repeating this date in context—such as “Ancy-Dornot was created on January 1, 2016”—helps embed the timeline into long-term memory through contextual anchoring.
